title: README never names the one target release 1 can run
observed: README presents bare `tao dev`; the run skill says bare `tao dev` opens no target and needs --ios, --android, --web or --desktop. Neither README nor the tutorial names `--web`, the only release-1 target.
impact: Following the README, `tao dev` opens nothing and the reader is not told which flag works.
expected: Release-1 instructions run the app with the web target they can use.
recheck: Run the README command sequence with a release-1 CLI.
